hooks.name: mcp-config-write-guard
hooks.description: A person must confirm any agent write to an MCP config (.kiro/settings/mcp.json, in a project or in the home folder). On macOS a native dialog asks, elsewhere a code typed on the terminal. Exit code 2 blocks the write. The dialog never shows what the agent wanted to write. Runs through scripts/kiro-hook.sh because Kiro gives hook commands a PATH without Node.
